description: Stage C: degradations. DELAY +20 ms on L5 (100 Mb/s access, on flow path) and L2 (1 Gb/s uplink, on flow path), plus +5 ms on L5 (magnitude sensitivity, idle). LOSS 5 % on L5 and L2 with 10 ICMP echoes per probe. BANDWIDTH cap 10 Mb/s / 100-packet queue on L5 at 0 (invisible), 5 (non-binding) and 40 Mb/s (offered > cap => congestion test). Healthy 40 Mb/s controls on uncapped links come from Stage B NONE runs. 3 independent repetitions.
